notes.title: Game Update Ver 1.14
notes.content:
Build 6282645 Update Ver 1.14 now contains this game patch

This update addresses a game bug that resulted if you found the vaccination syringe before visiting the Colonel. which prevented the quest from being completed.

notes.title: Blackstar Update Patch Ver 1.12
notes.content:
This game update addresses an memory leak issue in the 'Research Deck' level that would not correctly load the 'Main Hangar' scene after collecting the correct locked door access key. The end result of the bug was that the game could not continue as the next scene could not be completed. 

This patch addresses the memory leak which caused this fail state and now allows the player to continue the 'Main Hangar' scene and continue to successfully complete the next scene within the game.
